newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Hero sells Best Brands to Leon' Bakery.
newsitem.headline: Hero sells Best Brands to Leon' Bakery.

text.p: Swiss food and beverage maker Hero said it had sold its U.S. operation Best Brands Inc. to Leon's Bakery of the U.S. for an undisclosed amount.
Hero said in a statement that Best Brands, an industrial baking operation, has annual sales of around $110 million and has plants in St. Paul, Minnesota and Dallas, Texas.
Leon's Bakery is connected with Hicks, Muse, Tate & Fust Inc, a finance company that specialises in participations in the U.S. food sector.
Hero's chief executive Lutz Peters told a Swiss newspaper in November that it was in the process of selling Best Brands, but did not identify the buyer.
Hero is majority-owned by the German foods group Schwartau International GmbH.
